pyqgis_plugin.name: Fillet & Chamfer for QGIS 3.x (Interactive & Batch)
pyqgis_plugin.description: Interactive Fillet, Chamfer & Corner Restoration tools for QGIS with instant Batch Fillet/Chamfer for selected features.
pyqgis_plugin.about: Comprehensive CAD editing suite providing interactive Fillet (corner rounding), Chamfer (corner beveling), and Two-Edge Corner Restoration (Unfillet / Unchamfer) map tools for QGIS, along with an instant batch fillet and chamfer dock panel for selected vector features across QGIS 3.x and QGIS 4.x.
pyqgis_plugin.tags: cad, editing, fillet, chamfer, unfillet, corner, restore, geometry, digitizing, curve, batch, qgis4
pyqgis_plugin.change_log: 1.0.0.14: - Fixed complete translation resolution across 40 languages for the batch settings dock panel. - Added dynamic auto-sizing and repositioning to Corner Restoration HUD panel to ensure hints are never clipped. 1.0.0.13: - Added floating CAD HUD step-by-step hints and step-back workflow for Two-Edge Corner Restoration (Unfillet / Unchamfer) tool. - Added auto-dismissal timers (4-5s duration) to all QGIS message bar notification strips. - Removed drop shadow effects from floating canvas widgets to match native QGIS flat CAD panel styling. - Pinned floating canvas HUD panels firmly to the top-right corner of the canvas. - Fixed English and non-Ukrainian UI translations for all CAD actions, toolbar buttons, tooltips, and canvas HUD widgets with QgsApplication.locale() discovery. 1.0.0.12: - Restricted numeric stepper inputs to digits only and normalized decimal separator (dot/comma) handling across canvas HUD and batch panel. - Added interactive CAD Two-Edge Corner Restoration tool (Unfillet / Unchamfer) with real-time intersection preview. - Dedicated toolbar button with custom QGIS delete-badge icon for corner reconstruction. - Added Batch Processing dock panel for instant Fillet and Chamfer on selected features in QGIS 3.x and QGIS 4.x. - Fixed all Qt6 / PyQt6 / QGIS 4.0 scoped enum compatibility issues. - Full CRS adaptation (metric meters and geographic degrees EPSG:4326). - Localized in 40 languages (all official QGIS GUI locales). 1.0.0.0: - Initial release of Fillet & Chamfer Tool for QGIS.
